newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: SKorea BOK offers to sell dollars in forward trade.
newsitem.headline: SKorea BOK offers to sell dollars in forward trade.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea was seen offering to sell dollars in forward trading during the Thursday afternoon session trading to slow the U.S. unit's climb against the domestic currency, dealers said.
The central bank offered to sell dollars at 883.00 won in three-month forward trading and at 897.00 won in six-month forward trading, they said.
The central bank refused to comment on talk of its intervention in the interbank market.
Shortly after the offer, the won was trading at 868.90 against the dollar in early afternoon, against an opening rate of 868.30.
